quotes.text: [Manage payment links in Checkout studio (Private preview)](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout-studio.md): Use Checkout studio to configure, monitor performance, and run experiments across your Payment Links and other Checkout integrations.
Reuse multiple times with multiple customers, or limit the number of purchases.
[Revenue recovery](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/revenue-recovery.md) features, including Smart Retries and reminder emails are available for subscription payment links.

Dynamic payment methods filter for eligibility, displaying the most relevant payment methods to maximize conversion. Payment method availability [varies by product](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/payment-method-support.md#product-support).

old_evidence.text: | Reusability | Can't reuse; can duplicate and edit | Reuse multiple times, or limit number of purchases |
| Payment methods | 40+ managed in Dashboard | 40+ dynamic, managed in Dashboard |
| Collection tools | Smart Retries, reminder emails | Smart Retries + reminder emails for subscription links only |
Use the API to create and manage payment links

findings: This exact overview URL adds a Checkout Studio navigation entry explicitly marked Private preview (new line 73); old overview lines 25-39 list the earlier routes without it. The new page does not establish general access, account eligibility, or a proven experiment result. Add a dated, preview-qualified note to the overview portion of the shared source if reconciled.

The new comparison footnote makes explicit that dynamically presented methods are filtered for eligibility and availability varies by product (new line 107); old lines 21 and 51 simply said 40+ methods, dynamic and Dashboard-managed. Current source line 25 and wiki/concepts/stripe-payment-links.md lines 10 and 21 should be qualified so '40+' is an available catalog/eligible dynamic display description, not a promise that 40 or more methods appear for every customer, link, currency, or account.

Current concept line 24 calls reuse 'unlimited'; both old raw line 47 and new raw line 83 say links can be reused multiple times or purchase count can be limited, without an unlimited-volume promise. A scoped concept wording correction is needed. The source line 28 already uses the supported multiple-times wording.

The new overview expands the old compressed feature and Invoicing comparison tables, adds links and explanatory footnotes, and changes no-code integration effort to complexity 1/5. Core hosted-page, Adaptive Pricing, receipt/refund, buy-button, comparison, and subscription-recovery descriptions remain in substance. New line 95 retains the subscription-only recovery boundary from old line 54.

The assigned raw is only the payment-links overview URL. Source lines 44-55 and raw_files lines 8-14 contain API, limits, pricing defaults, mobile, shipping, promotion, and customization material from seven other dated raw identities. Preserve those separately and do not attribute them to this overview, infer that they changed, or replace their provenance with the November overview.
substantive_changes: New private-preview Checkout Studio route for configuring, monitoring, and experimenting across Payment Links and other Checkout integrations, with no general availability implication.
New explicit dynamic-method eligibility and product-availability qualification in the overview footnote.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the 2026-04-20 overview capture as historical evidence for hosted page, no-code shareability, 40+ catalog, Adaptive Pricing, reuse with optional purchase limit, Invoicing comparison, and subscription-only recovery.
Preserve each of the source's other seven raw_files and the exact claims they support independently of this assigned overview identity.
Keep Checkout Studio's Private preview status prominent; a link in the overview is not proof of access or live execution.
conflicts: Current source line 25 and wiki/concepts/stripe-payment-links.md lines 10 and 21 omit the new overview's eligibility/product-availability qualification for the dynamically displayed 40+ catalog.
Wiki/concepts/stripe-payment-links.md line 24 says reusable an unlimited number of times, stronger than old raw line 47 and new raw line 83 support.
The current source overview portion and Stripe index line 30 omit the new Private preview Checkout Studio route; it should not be described as generally available.
Any attempt to update source lines 44-55 from this one URL would conflate distinct raw identities and their dated evidence.
unresolved_questions: The Checkout Studio preview's account eligibility, activation, supported experiments, and eventual availability are not established by this overview link.

This overview does not determine exact per-country, currency, product, customer, or account method eligibility, nor does it independently revalidate the separate API and pricing-default claims in the shared source.
